abstract.p: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional performance across diverse tasks. To harness their capabilities for Textto-SQL, we introduce R 3 (Review-Rebuttal-Revision), a consensus-based multi-agent system for Text-to-SQL tasks. R 3 achieves the new state-of-the-art performance of 89.9 on the Spider test set. In the meantime, R 3 achieves 61.80 on the Bird development set. R 3 outperforms existing single-LLM and multi-agent Text-to-SQL systems by 1.3% to 8.1% on Spider and Bird, respectively. Surprisingly, we find that for Llama-3-8B, R 3 outperforms chain-ofthought prompting by over 20%, even outperforming GPT-3.5 on the Spider development set. We open-source our codebase at https: //github.com/1ring2rta/R3.
